description: This Java source file implements the ContentDao interface, providing data access methods for Content entities in a shopping or content management system. Methods include listing Content by type, retrieving by code, ID, or URL, with filtering options for store and language.

classes.name: ContentDaoImpl
classes.description: A Data Access Object implementation for Content entities, providing methods to query and retrieve content based on various filters such as type, code, store, and language.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Content objects filtered by ContentType, MerchantStore, and optionally Language, ordered by sortOrder.

methods.name: listNameByType
methods.description: Returns a list of ContentDescription objects for Content filtered by ContentType, MerchantStore, and Language, including name and URL.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches a single Content entity by its code and MerchantStore.

methods.name: getByLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves Content by its ID and associated Language.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves Content by its unique ID.

methods.name: getByCode (overload)
methods.description: Fetches Content by code, MerchantStore, and Language.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieves ContentDescription by store and SEO URL.
